verses.1: We know, brothers, that this gift from God has been given in the churches of Macedonia.
verses.2: Because in many trials of sorrow, their excessive joy and their deep poverty became too much for them to bear.
verses.3: For by strength, I swear, and with strength, they remained steadfast.
verses.4: After much hesitation, they finally agreed to do so. For the sake of our service and fellowship with those who are holy…
verses.5: And not when we ascended, but they first gave themselves to the Lord, and also to us by the will of God.
verses.6: To ask us, Titus, to do as he has promised, and to carry out this favor for you.
verses.7: But just as you overdo everything in every situation, so also do you overdo matters of faith, reason, knowledge, and all kinds of love that comes from us towards you. In this way, you can also overdo things in this regard.
verses.8: I say not by force, but through the admiration of others and their genuine love for you.
verses.9: For consider the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that by means of you He might become rich, so that you might be made rich through His poverty.
verses.10: And I give you my opinion in this matter. This is indeed what is beneficial for you, since you have not only been willing to do things, but also have always desired to do so since last year.
verses.11: And now, you have also completed what you were supposed to do. In other words, just as the desire to do something arises from within us, so too does the act of doing it come from that same desire.
verses.12: For if eagerness exists at all, then it exists whether or not it is well-founded.
verses.13: For it is not for others to enjoy benefits; it’s for you to suffer. But it comes from equality.
verses.14: In this present time, your wealth should become their poverty, so that their poverty can also become your wealth. In this way, equality will be achieved.
verses.15: As it is written: He did not exaggerate in the important matters, and he did not belittle those that were insignificant.
verses.16: But may the love for God’s gift be cherished in your hearts, in Titus’s heart as well.
verses.17: Since he only made that request, it’s even more remarkable that there was someone who came to you directly and openly.
verses.18: We also appointed his brother as the person who would carry out this task in the ministry of evangelization, through all the churches.
verses.19: Not only that, but also, through the efforts of the churches, we were freed from our obligations to them. This was done in accordance with the manner in which we should serve our Lord. And this was also due to our willingness to do so.
verses.20: Let us not allow anyone to bathe us in this arrogance that we practice.
verses.21: For we are to be praised not only before our Lord, but also before human beings.
verses.22: We have also assigned to them our brother, whom we considered to be very valuable many times. Now, he is even more valuable to you.
verses.23: Whether for Titus’s sake, my fellow believers and collaborators with you; or as our brothers, apostles of the churches… may Christ have glory.
verses.24: Therefore, we will show your love and our pride for you by revealing it to them in the presence of the churches.
